Heather Nelson Shouldice (Eastern Michigan University; author of *Weaving It All Together*) writes
[Everyday Musicality](https://everydaymusicality.com): a podcast on Music Learning Theory and the blog *Research to Real Life*. These pages
link to every post with the site's own summary; the posts themselves are read at her site, used with her permission. The podcast pages are
short show notes, so an episode's summary here comes from the notes and the title, not the audio (each step says which). Songs and pieces a
post names are in the [Tune Directory](../practice/tune-directory.qmd).
